records.title: Loan
records.body:
## Bounds

A loan covers **one copy** and *one member*. The desk kiosk prints the due slip; see use-case/lending.borrow-copy for the flow.

Borrowing rules:

- One copy lends to one member at a time.
- A loan lasts `three weeks`.

Counts:

1. Scan the member card.
2. Scan the copy.

| Week | Loans |
| --- | ---: |
| First | 120 |
| Second | 140 |

```
scan member, scan copy, print slip
```

> A loan is a promise to bring the copy back.

---

Read the [lending guide](https://example.com/lending) or visit https://example.com/desks.
